services.desc: "Grayslake Fire & Rescue: Past, Present, Prepared:” The exhibit is the collaborative work of the Society, the Heritage Center, and the Grayslake Fire Department to celebrate over 125 years of the Grayslake Fire Protection District! From a small volunteer fire department, to a professional organization with that responds to the emergencies of more than 20,000 people, the Grayslake Fire District continues to protect and serve the community to the highest standard. Learn about the fire department, their accolades, their trials, and how they continue to evolve to be safer and more efficient. Opens on July 18, 2026 and will run until June 12, 2027. "A Golden Milestone: 50 Years, 50 Treasures:"
